title: Rails Testing Basics
intro: Rails testing basics interview questions for freshers cover enough testing knowledge to pass a junior-level interview. This module covers why tests matter (regression safety, refactoring confidence, living documentation), the test pyramid at a basic level (unit vs integration vs end-to-end), RSpec syntax (describe, context, it, expect(x).to eq(y)), Minitest assertions (assert_equal, assert_nil, assert_raises, refute), how to run tests (rails test vs bundle exec rspec), model tests that verify validations and basic methods, controller tests that verify response status and redirects, fixtures vs FactoryBot (test data helpers), the test database (separate DB that resets between runs), and the red-green-refactor cycle. Every answer includes a minimal test example.
